title: Microsoft outage disrupts email at Laredo colleges, halts WIC services
excerpt: A Microsoft outage knocked out email at Laredo College and TAMIU and left local WIC services unavailable on Nov. 12, with the disruption still ongoing late Thursday night.
content:
A Microsoft outage disrupted email services at Laredo College and Texas A&M International University and left local WIC services unavailable on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, according to KGNS.

Both colleges warned students and staff that they might have trouble getting into their email while the outage continued, KGNS reported. The WIC program said its services were unavailable and posted a notice apologizing for the inconvenience, explaining that services were temporarily down because of a system outage.

People who had WIC appointments on Nov. 12 could call the WIC office to reschedule, according to KGNS.

As of late Thursday night, the outage was still ongoing, and Microsoft was working to restore services, KGNS reported. The disruption was part of a wider Microsoft Outlook outage affecting email services across the United States on Nov. 12, according to Texas Border Business.

KGNS did not report how many people were affected or how long the outage would last.

Sources: KGNS; Texas Border Business, Nov. 12, 2026.
